name: xbox-pc-backward-compat-21-games-november-13
lines:
أضافت إكس بوكس (Xbox) اليوم 21 لعبة
من جهازها الأصلي إلى PC
من بينها Star Wars Battlefront II

كما تُمنح الإنجازات لأول مرة
في أربع ألعاب

وتنطبق الإنجازات أيضًا عند اللعب
على Xbox One و Xbox Series

يتطلب التشغيل Windows 11
والتوفر في أسواق محددة
credits: لقطات من نسخة PC القديمة على Steam
headline:
ألعاب Xbox الأصلية
على PC تبلغ 25 لعبة
label: رسمي
bed_reason: checked the Steam gameplay captures of Jedi Academy, Battlefront II, KOTOR and KOTOR II (the four with footage; Xbox Wire's post has no video): spectrograms show broadband impulsive in-game effects and voices throughout with no music-led stretch, so no usable trailer music; Morrowind (640x480) and Republic Commando (HUD only) not used

angle.hook: Xbox's original console library on PC jumps from 4 to 25 games in one day
angle.why_now: Xbox Wire published the list on 12 Nov (21:02 UTC, 01:02 Dubai 13 Nov) as part of the Xbox 25th anniversary, and the games are available from that day
angle.what_it_means_here: Players with a Windows 11 PC or handheld in a supported market can play Star Wars and TimeSplitters classics, and the achievements also appear on Xbox One and Series consoles; UAE and Saudi availability is not stated, Xbox says select markets only
angle.payoff: achievements for the first time in four original Xbox games, on PC and consoles
